1051 RAJESHWAR SINGH v. SUBRATA ROY SAHARA & ORS. Contempt Petition (Civil) No. 224 of 2011 IN Civil Appeal No.10660 of 2010 DECEMBER 9, 2013 [G.S. SINGHVI AND K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN, JJ.) A B Investigation - Court monitored criminal investigation - C Interference in - Prevention - by any person, however high he may be - On facts, the a/legations raised by the D petitioner in the contempt petition were of very serious nature - The petitioner invoked Arts. 129 and 142 of the Constitution to apprise the Supreme Court of the difficulties he faced while carrying on court
